concern_summary: This concern includes the creation and management of distance requests, encompassing validation, processing, and user interaction related to distance tracking and transaction management.
This concern encompasses functionalities for calculating geographical distance between coordinates and ensuring accurate distance retrieval from transaction objects.
This concern focuses on the creation and management of distance expense transactions, including setup and reporting based on traveled distances.
This concern involves functionalities for obtaining the current geographical location of the user and computing locations based on previous data, enabling real-time location services.
This concern revolves around distance measurement management that includes calculations of waypoints and the representation of distance-related data on maps, ensuring accurate distance visualization.

This concern relates to the synchronization of location data from QuickBooks Online, managing user settings to enable or disable this synchronization and ensuring that the relevant data is available for user needs.

This concern focuses on validating and processing waypoint addresses, managing user inputs for routing calculations, and ensuring that at least two distinct waypoints are provided for accurate navigation.
This concern involves managing and presenting a list of years, allowing users to filter and sort the years based on their preferences for selection.
This concern identifies and displays subscription benefits based on the type of subscription, assisting users in understanding their available options.
